summary: The proof is correct and complete. The exact-cell indexing gives each closed positive cap area q_{N\setminus\{i\}}=|A_2|/4 up to zero-area cutting lines, and the zero-area double-positive regions imply pairwise disjoint cap interiors. The three-cap equality case applies with the stated orientations. Its three distinct medial lines cut off the three distinct corner triangles, so their complementary global halfplanes intersect in exactly the central medial triangle, hence T_\gamma=Q_N. The definition \gamma=1-(L_1+L_2+L_3)>2 gives \sum_i\ell_i=-\gamma with the correct sign. The affine isomorphism F identifies T_1 with the negative simplex and T_\gamma with its translated \gamma-dilate; pulling this relation back gives a genuine planar homothety of ratio \gamma and therefore area ratio \gamma^2. Finally q_N>0 and \gamma>2 yield r_N\le q_N/\gamma^2<q_N/4, which contradicts r_N=1/10 when q_N=1/4.
